chunks: And in the narration of Mu'āwiyah ibn 'Ammār, from Abū 'Abdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
There is no harm in a man entering ihram in a marked garment, but leaving it is more beloved to me if he is able to use something else.

key_terms.غَيْرِهِ: something other than it; an alternative
key_terms.يُحْرِمَ: to enter the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wear a marked or decorated garment while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about clothing in the state of ihram. It indicates that wearing a marked garment is permissible, though avoiding it is preferable when one has an alternative.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2605 - In a narration from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdullah (as), he said:
"There is no harm if a man enters Ihram wearing an embroidered garment, but avoiding it is more beloved to me if he has the means to wear something else."
